task_set: 40 of the 200 Odysseys tasks (every fifth task id in tasks.csv order)
agent: dassi 0.89.0 plus a benchmark-only pin of the OpenRouter route to the DekaLLM then Parasail hosts (not in any release)

judge.code: Odysseys authors' scorer, run_full_trajectory_per_rubric.py at 95307c76, unmodified, no step cap

cost.basis: OpenRouter-billed, measured on the last 15 tasks (one clean run with no failed work). The harness's own per-task cost line is about twice the bill, so it is not published here.
cost.total_basis: whole effort for both benchmarks, including shards lost to container out-of-memory kills, one run that hit exhausted credit, pilots and diagnosis

reruns.reason: first attempt lost to a killed container (exit 137) or exhausted credit; each re-run once and the re-run counts
